$about: The whisper.cpp build Rosalena downloads to run speech-to-text models from the Models page (ggml-*.bin in ~/.rosalena/models/voice/whisper). DATA: src/voice-runner.mjs picks one asset by platform, checks its sha256 and unpacks it into ~/.rosalena/whisper.cpp. Pinned to a release at least two weeks old, with the digest GitHub reports for the asset. The CPU (BLAS) build on purpose: a CUDA build is 685 MB, and the whisper models people dictate with run in real time on a processor. A model runs as one whisper-cli process per transcription, so it is loaded when you speak and gone when the text comes back.
